About

Meet Ryan

Third-generation master painter & restoration specialist. 25+ years of experience.

Third-generation master painter25+ yearsPainting & home enhancement
“I love bringing someone’s vision for their project to life—and doing it right the first time.”

I'm a third-generation master painter and restoration specialist, with more than 25 years of hands-on experience. I grew up around this trade, and I learned early that a great result starts with careful preparation, knowing your products, and using the right techniques for the job.

I recently moved down from Pennsylvania, and I'm excited to bring that experience, high-end craftsmanship, and the kind of personal customer service I believe every homeowner deserves to this community.

My work has taken me from large commercial projects, including Lehigh University and upscale restaurants, to smaller historic homes with original woodwork that deserves special care. I've worked on properties in downtown Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, that have been part of the city's historic walking tours. I especially enjoy restoration because every surface has its own challenges, and getting the details right matters.

What I love most is helping people bring their vision for their home to life. I've worked alongside homeowners and interior designers to turn ideas into something beautiful and lasting. I take pride in explaining the options, choosing the right products and application methods, and doing the work properly the first time.

Outside of work, I love being in nature—hiking, mountain biking, and trail running whenever I can. I'm also a proud uncle to two little girls. Family and time outdoors are a big part of who I am, and I bring that same down-to-earth attitude to the people I work with.

At the end of a project, I want you to love the finished space and feel just as good about the experience of getting there. That's always the goal.
